Extension

Install and configure extensions to add custom functionality.

Extensions allow you to customize Manager with additional features and integrations.

Name

Enter a descriptive name to identify this extension. This name appears in the list of extensions and helps you manage multiple extensions.

Use clear names like 'Customer signature pad' or 'Inventory barcode scanner' to indicate the extension's purpose.

Source

Select how you want to add custom functionality to Manager:

ExternalURL - Embed content from another website or web application using an iframe

CustomHTML - Write your own HTML, CSS, and JavaScript code directly

Endpoint

Enter the full URL of the external web page or application you want to embed. This creates an iframe that displays the external content.

The URL must use HTTPS for security. Common uses include embedding calculators, maps, or third-party tools.

The external page will have access to form data through URL parameters and can interact with Manager using JavaScript.

Html

Write custom HTML code that will be inserted directly into the Manager page. You can include HTML, CSS styles, and JavaScript.

Your code has access to form data and can interact with Manager's interface. Use this for custom buttons, calculations, or UI enhancements.

Common uses include adding custom validation, auto-calculations, or integration with external services via JavaScript.

Placement

Specify where this extension should appear within Manager. Enter the path segment that identifies the target page.

Common placements include:

- 'receipt-form' - Appears when creating or editing receipts

- 'payment-form' - Appears when creating or editing payments

- 'sales-invoice-form' - Appears when creating or editing sales invoices

- 'sales-invoice-view' - Appears when viewing sales invoices

- 'customer-form' - Appears when creating or editing customers

The extension will only load on pages matching this exact path.

Inactive

Check this box to temporarily disable this extension without deleting it. Inactive extensions won't load on any pages.

This is useful for troubleshooting or when you need to temporarily turn off custom functionality.
